item.title: Girls Basketball: Duluth Denfeld & Superior Both Bounce Back at Home
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The Duluth Denfeld girls basketball team looked to snap a four-game losing streak on Monday, hosting Hibbing. The Hunters take care of business at home, defeating the Bluejackets 50-47. Over in Wisconsin, Superior took on Esko for the second time this season. The Spartans earn the 58-33 win over Esko.
